name: agent-monitor
description: Real-time agent observability. Lifecycle hooks push normalized events to a local-only dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:17894 (activity, tools, tokens, errors, compaction, permissions).

interface.longDescription: Streams session, tool, model-request, token, compaction and permission events to a bundled local server bound to 127.0.0.1:17894. Open the dashboard from the plugin skill or http://127.0.0.1:17894. No data leaves the machine.
defaultPrompt: Open the Agent Monitor dashboard and summarize current agent activity.
